title: Frontier risk and preparedness
snippet: To support the safety of highly-capable AI systems, we are developing our approach to catastrophic risk preparedness, including building a Preparedness team and launching a challenge.

title: Frontier Model Forum updates
snippet: Together with Anthropic, Google, and Microsoft, we’re announcing the new Executive Director of the Frontier Model Forum and a new $10 million AI Safety Fund.

title: DALL·E 3 is now available in ChatGPT Plus and Enterprise
snippet: We developed a safety mitigation stack to ready DALL·E 3 for wider release and are sharing updates on our provenance research.

title: Building AI-powered apps for business
snippet: Retool uses GPT-4 to give businesses a fast, secure way to build AI-powered apps.

title: Evolving online forms into dynamic data
snippet: Typeform evolves online forms into dynamic and conversational data collection experiences with GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.

title: Simplifying contract reviews with AI
snippet: Ironclad uses GPT-4 to simplify the contract review process.
